task.description: Translate the listed Sai files from Russian into English, following decisions/0080-english-instructions.md exactly (read it first, including the glossary in item 5). Rules: (1) the meaning must not change — same rules, numbers, names, order of sections; do not shorten, improve or add rules; (2) keep unchanged every file name, identifier, field name, AP-NNN, REQ-NNN, ISS-NNNN, decision number, command, role code and code block; (3) the front matter keys stay, but name: and description: are written in English (the name keeps the form "Sai <Role> (CODE)"); (4) text that the owner or a customer reads and tool error messages stay in the original Russian when quoted, followed by a short English gloss in parentheses; (5) plain, short English sentences, one term per concept (use the glossary); (6) no computer paths and no names of other projects in the text; (7) write the file in place with the Write tool, do not run prettier on .md outside tools/. Do not use git checkout/reset/stash/clean and do not commit. Do not stop the demo server on port 4782. Before close run: cd tools && npm run handoffs-check and npm run traces. In result list the files you translated and anything you were unsure about (issues). Files to translate: .claude/agents/: doc-updater, frontend-dev, gui-design-analyst, idea-analyst, idea-judge, issue-fixer, market-researcher, orchestrator, plan-validator, plan-writer (10 files).

issues.text: Russian strings kept verbatim with an English gloss because files that stay Russian or other tools use them: section/status names of STATE.md, docs/issues and docs/audits/README.md (e.g. «Закрыто», «готов», «Решение владельца о старте», closed, <дата>, дефекта нет), the fields «Что случилось / Почему это плохо / Как правильно / Где найдено» of docs/anti-patterns.md, headings of the research and plan files (## Что нашли (проверено ГГГГ-ММ-ДД), ## Где искали, ## Ценность одной фразой, ## Ограничения), the source and assumption marks «(источник: ...)», «допущение», «не найдено», market marks [Казахстан] etc., the ORCH check verdict «FAIL принят», the audit mark «не подтверждено», the window text «привязано автоматически», the sample inventory marks «переносится» / «переносится с изменением» / «не переносится», and the placeholder parts of commands. If other translators change these names or the files that hold them to English, these gloss spots must be aligned in the review.

References to section headings of the workflow documents and handoffs.md (e.g. 'What a defect looks like', 'General rules for all roles', 'Breaks and interruptions', 'Short path', 'Stop conditions', 'Handoffs', 'Variant', 'Report to the owner', 'Merge and report to the owner') were written as English names of those headings; they must match the headings chosen by the translators of those files. The same for the CLAUDE.md quote 'ORCH writes only this itself'.

In orchestrator.md I added one clause that is not in the Russian original but follows decision 0080 item 3: 'The report to the owner is written in plain Russian.' (the original said only 'in plain words'). Remove if the owner wants no such clarification. Also the Pixel Office note command keeps the placeholder <как понял> with a gloss.
